comments.body: Does it matter what Adv. profession I am when im trying to get this quest? Or is having the correct skill levels enough?

comments.author: Northerner
comments.body: Requisite skills are all that matter for any adventure quest. That, and any fame requirements, which some have. To find info on that often requires digging into the Taiwanese wiki, there isn't a good English source for all the quest fame reqs.
